units.text: INT. GHOSTS - CONTINUOUS
Nearer.

Now don't be a fool and stand in your own light, Regina. What's to become of you out here? Your mistress has given you a lot of learning; but what good is that to you? You're to look after the children at the new Orphanage, I hear. Is that the sort of thing for you, eh? Are you so dead set on wearing your life out for a pack of dirty brats?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: No; if things go as I want them to--Well there's no saying--there's no saying.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: What do you mean by "there's no saying"?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Never you mind.--How much money have you saved?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: What with one thing and another, a matter of seven or eight hundred crowns.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: A "krone" is equal to one shilling and three-halfpence.
That's not so bad.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: It's enough to make a start with, my girl.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Aren't you thinking of giving me any?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: No, I'm blest if I am!
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Not even of sending me a scrap of stuff for a new dress?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Come to town with me, my lass, and you'll soon get dresses enough.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Pooh! I can do that on my own account, if I want to.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: No, a father's guiding hand is what you want, Regina. Now, I've got my eye on a capital house in Little Harbour Street. They don't want much ready-money; and it could be a sort of a Sailors' Home, you know.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: But I will not live with you! I have nothing whatever to do with you. Be off!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: You wouldn't stop long with me, my girl. No such luck! If you knew how to play your cards, such a fine figure of a girl as you've grown in the last year or two--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Well?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: You'd soon get hold of some mate--or maybe even a captain--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: I won't marry any one of that sort. Sailors have no savoir vivre .
units.name: REGINA

units.text: What's that they haven't got?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: I know what sailors are, I tell you. They're not the sort of people to marry.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Then never mind about marrying them. You can make it pay all the same.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: More confidentially.
He--the Englishman--the man with the yacht--he came down with three hundred dollars, he did; and she wasn't a bit handsomer than you.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Making for him.
Out you go!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Falling back.
Come, come! You're not going to hit me, I hope.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Yes, if you begin talking about mother I shall hit you. Get away with you, I say!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Drives him back towards the garden door.
And don't slam the doors. Young Mr. Alving--
units.name: REGINA

units.text: He's asleep; I know. You're mightily taken up about young Mr. Alving--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: More softly.
Oho! you don't mean to say it's him as--?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Be off this minute! You're crazy, I tell you! No, not that way. There comes Pastor Manders. Down the kitchen stairs with you.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Towards the right.

Yes, yes, I'm going. But just you talk to him as is coming there. He's the man to tell you what a child owes its father. For I am your father all the same, you know. I can prove it from the church register.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: He goes out through the second door to the right, which REGINA has opened, and closes again after him.
REGINA glances hastily at herself in the mirror, dusts herself with her pocket handkerchief; and settles her necktie; then she busies herself with the flowers.
PASTOR MANDERS, wearing an overcoat, carrying an umbrella, and with a small travelling-bag on a strap over his shoulder, comes through the garden door into the conservatory.
Good-morning, Miss Engstrand.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Turning round, surprised and pleased.
No, really! Good morning, Pastor Manders. Is the steamer in already?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: It is just in.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Enters the sitting-room.
